title: She Left When You Fell? Good. Now You Know.

scenes.text: She left when the money ran out. When the car was gone. When you couldn't be the man in the pictures anymore.
It hurts. I know. But stop calling it a loss. It was a lesson.
Some people love the life you give them, not the man you are. Now you know the difference.
Stop checking her stories. Stop rehearsing what you'd say if she came back.
Every minute spent on someone who walked away is a minute stolen from the man you're about to become.
Put that energy into your body. Into your work. Into your peace.
One day you'll realize her leaving wasn't the moment you lost everything. It was the moment you got yourself back.
